critical_code_review_comments: LoginPage.jsx: 'Forgot your password?' link duplicated in form — one at line 65 and one at line 73. Remove one.

documents.py: The `_save_file` function stores files relative to /app/backend, but returns path relative to /app/backend parent. If the server ever restarts and UPLOAD_DIR changes, orphaned files may occur. Low risk in current setup.

admin.py: PUT /api/admin/users/{id} — if user has no member record, member-only fields (gender, date_of_birth, group, location_id, program) silently succeed on user update but won't be stored on member (since no member exists). This is acceptable fallback behavior but worth noting.

portal.py: GET /api/portal/documents now returns dict with {documents, requests, member_id} — frontend PortalDocuments.jsx correctly handles both new dict format and legacy flat array. Good backward compatibility.
